content.value: A strip of lead with initial dimensions 24mm x 24mm x 150mm is forged between two flat dies to a final size of 6mm x 96mm x 150mm. If the coefficient of friction between the job and the dies is 0.25, determine the maximum forging force. The average yield stress of lead in tension is 7 kN/mm².
